notes.title: Patch v0.7.9
notes.content:
Enemy tactics can now be viewed from the top-right menu, enabling the player to plan ahead.

The first steps of the prologue tutorial are now more guided.

Minor fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.7.8
notes.content:
Fixed an issue that prevented the "Afterlife" tactic card for the enemy Undeads from being played.

Fixed an issue that prevented the "Dark Tome" tactic card for the enemy First Man Conclave from being played.

Minor balance tweaks and small QoL improvements.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.7.7
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where a combat event could be generated in the same travel segment after the last crew member succumbed to wound loss due to lack of supplies.

Added new QoL VFX and improved some existing ones.

Made minor improvements to the Spanish localization.

notes.title: Demo Update: Chainshots and Assaults!
notes.content:
Ahoy there!

After recovering from the Steam Next Fest hangover, we’ve polished our demo with the help of all the brave players who gave it a try – and we’ve added some exciting new content!

You now have access to Chainshots, a powerful type of cannonball designed to wreck enemy cannons and stations with precision and style.


[table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="169,343,"][tr][td colwidth="169"]

[/td][td colwidth="343"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/368a8134a88c8a4ec146d3b7429495d2e5b5c470.png"]
[/td][td]

[/td][/tr][/table]
These deadly rounds can be fired from the newly introduced cannon: the Thunderer! You can get your hands on it at the Emporium, or as a reward in certain (rare) events.


[table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="202,284,"][tr][td colwidth="202"]

[/td][td colwidth="284"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/e4893eb860b39b7315fe687c4166793a540cdf86.gif"]
[/td][td]

[/td][/tr][/table]


And last but not least, we’ve added a brand-new battle event type: Assaults. In these encounters, enemies have boarded your ship – and the only path to victory is a fierce close-quarters fight! 

You’ll find Rum especially handy during these skirmishes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/f2019bab264a93cc8e28dff2bd0d12c93a0b2be5.gif"]



So, set sail for the demo, test out the new content, and don’t forget to share your thoughts with us.

Fair winds!



Patch notes:

Assaults are now available as a type of combat event

Chainshot tactic card and Thunderer cannon available as rewards or to be purchased at the Emporium.

Rendering graphics pipeline simplified to address potential crashing problems and improve overall performance

Fixed some in-combat situations where the game could end on a "softlock"

Fixed a problem where selecting certain resolution options was not scaling the window correctly

Fixed incorrect interactions with fire sources

Added some QoL changes

notes.title: Demo v0.5.5 Hotfix
notes.content:
Solved issue that was causing softlocks in some situations during combat (thanks to everyone who took the time to report it — you rock!)

Added some small QoL changes

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.4
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the defeat track could play twice in some situations

Fixed fire sources not damaging crew members when pushed, and not killing enemy crew in certain cases

Fixed a softlock when the last enemy crew member was killed by fire

Minor bug fixes to the journal "new entry" marker behavior

notes.title: Demo patch 0.5.3
notes.content:
Added Journal system that contains the quests from specific events. It’s accessible from the upper-right menu bar.

Increased the standard max number of tiles a crew member can be moved to 5.

Fixed an issue that could cause softlocks in certain situations.

Other minor bugfixes.

Added some QoL changes.

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.2
notes.content:
Added escape mechanism during combat in Adventure Mode
 Updated starting crew and artillery positions for the Golden Maiden Merchants ship
 Fixed issue where the Seafarer bonus was not applied if East Sails was active before manning a ship system
 Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.5.1
notes.content:
Added some QoL features related to on-grid tooltips.
 Improved several prologue tutorial dialogues.
 Fixed a bug where enemy artillery could sometimes target the wrong ship zone.
 Fixed an issue where grid squares weren’t highlighted correctly when holding the Alt key with an artillery piece selected.

notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a major update to our demo!
You can now select “New Game,” choose from available captains and ships, and play through the first sector, set in the Blue Sea.

The Prologue has also been improved, making it more accessible and better at explaining new mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/7771e1287571f0f5f7fb1c827ff2f0a4f95fcb33.png

We can’t wait for you to embark on your first adventure in Red Rogue Sea! Be sure to let us know about your early journeys.

Fair winds!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.2
notes.content: Solve an overlapping problem that could occur when a crew member was revived after being knocked out

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.content:
The Demo Prologue has been reworked to provide a more streamlined learning curve.
Several Quality of Life improvements have been added.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.7
notes.content:
Added in-battle tooltips while holding “Alt” and hovering over a crew member, artillery piece, or station.
 Added new mouse cursors with enhanced contrast to improve visibility.
 Fixed an error where a crew member’s health bar visuals were reset to full when assaulting the opposite ship.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.6
notes.content:
Allow the player to cancel a card selection after selecting the crew member who will perform the action, to avoid a “soft-lock” scenario.
 Improvements related to on-hover cursor behavior.

notes.title: Prologue Hotfix 0.3.5
notes.content:
Fixed a problem that could affect game flow while playing a card, potentially causing a hard lock.
 Fixed a problem that prevented ship hold holes from being clickable for repair.
 Fixed dead animations not triggering in some situations.

notes.title: New class showcase: the Stevedore
notes.content:
“When storms rage and battles tear through the seas, no crew member is more valuable than the Stevedore. Hardened by years of loading cargo, patching up hulls, and keeping ships afloat, these skilled sailors are the backbone of any vessel. They don’t seek glory in battle, rather they ensure that the ship survives long enough to claim victory.”

Ahoy, Captains!

The seas are ruthless, and survival is never guaranteed. Today, we introduce a new class that could make all the difference between staying afloat and meeting a watery grave. Meet the Stevedore, whose mastery of ship maintenance keeps the vessel in fighting shape even in the harshest conditions.

Bail & Repair – The Art of Staying Afloat

Every ship takes damage, but not every crew can endure. Stevedores specialize in two crucial skills that set them apart from the rest.

While any sailor can remove water from a flooding deck, a Stevedore does it with unmatched efficiency. They bail out more water in a single action than any other crewmember, keeping the ship from sinking even in the direst situations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/0f0fddd02e1ed00a4a35fa3134e638ecac34b001.png

[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/d79b8f27463d90e5fa49b2f242fd2b0f1b5a743f.png

A Stevedore’s skill with repairs is second to none. With a single action, they can fully restore a damaged station, instantly bringing key ship functions back online when it matters most.

With these abilities, a Stevedore captain brings resilience and sustainability to any fleet, ensuring that even the fiercest storms and bloodiest engagements don’t spell the end.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/6083c05e7991e0c8d537770409b08f0deb00923e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/83460727e3c8a191b1b7f011a28f49ced624823e.png

Are you ready to test your survival instincts and outlast the enemy? Choose wisely, captain, as the Red Rogue Sea public demo is within reach! Make sure to wishlist and subscribe to our newsletter to get notified.

notes.title: Red Rogue Sea Nominated for the Godot Game Awards 2024
notes.content:
Ahoy, adventurers,

We’re pleased to share some exciting news: Red Rogue Sea has been nominated for the Godot Game Awards 2024 in the Best Strategy Game category! This recognition means a lot to us, and it wouldn’t have been possible without the support of our loyal crew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/9f6a3395364ae15a23e67cff0348c6c1867a018f.png

We’re honored to be in the company of such fantastic games. A special mention to our fellow nominees:

 Backpack Battles
 Coldridge
 Gamblers
 Fogpiercer

These are all outstanding projects, and we’re proud to stand alongside them.

Our gratitude goes out to Stay at Home Dev for organizing these awards and for their dedication to indie games and the Godot engine community. Their support creates opportunities like this to celebrate creativity and innovation in game development.

Now, we’d love your help. Voting is open, and your support could make a big difference. Show some love for indie studios and Godot-powered games by casting your vote.

👉 Vote here!

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your encouragement keeps us inspired to keep building and improving Red Rogue Sea.

Warm regards,
The Red Rogue Sea Captains

notes.title: New class spotlight: Meet the Thug
notes.content:
Meet The Thug! 🏴‍☠️

Emerging from the darkest alleys and most treacherous ports, the Thug has survived a life filled with hardship and tough choices. Once a brawler in the seediest taverns, he now channels his raw strength and cunning into your quest for plunder.

Ahoy, gamers!

This week, we're introducing the second of the six crew member classes available at launch: the Thug.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/10df88d8dc408c418580c3db981828eb130b01c4.png

The Thug is a brawler who excels at close-quarters combat. He can be deployed to board enemy vessels and storm fortifications, or to defend your ship from would-be attackers. He's especially useful when playing cards such as Brawl!, amplifying the effect of these tactic cards. The Thug will also unlock some intimidation actions during your adventure events.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/4b21f329fc0396f00776fd059ca5a96f9c99ee43.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/fe590938f19e967100944be5eb53eab6dafa87c4.png

Don't miss out! If you haven't subscribed yet, be sure to sign up for our newsletter to stay informed on all the latest news and important dates, and to unlock exclusive in-game rewards!

That brings us to the end of this week's update. Keep an eye out for our next post, where we'll introduce another one of the crew member classes available at launch.

Fair winds!

notes.title: New class spotlight: Meet the Deserter
notes.content:
Meet The Deserter!🏴‍☠️ 

Once a loyal sailor in the royal army fleet, she left behind her regiment and uniform to follow the call of freedom on the high seas. Skilled in artillery and fearless in the face of danger, The Deserter is a tough addition to any crew. Just beware - trust might be an issue, as her past holds a few too many burned bridges.

Ahoy Gamers!

This week, we’re introducing the first of the six crew member classes available at launch: The Deserter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/073e305cfe2ef8c06c6d9e39b647d50c2a5134e5.png

The Deserter is the crew member who excels at handling any type of artillery on your ship, making her the perfect choice for players who prefer an artillery-focused strategy. She’s especially useful when playing cards like Cannonball, adding devastating power to your attacks.
